items.title: Zelensky to press Nato for air defence systems after intense Russian strikes
items.description: The Ukrainian president will use the Nato meeting in Turkey to argue he needs more interceptor missiles.

items.title: Jailers and officials at Russia's 'torture prisons' in Ukraine exposed by BBC
items.description: Former prisoners accuse the men of abuse in detention centres and want to see them brought to trial.

items.title: Marine Le Pen's moment of truth: Why Tuesday court verdict matters for France
items.description: The leader of France's National Rally leads the opinion polls ahead of the 2027 presidential election and will now find out if she can stand.

items.title: Explosions injure 18 in Damascus during Macron's visit
items.description: As reports of the blasts came in, state television said the Syrian president had welcomed Macron at the presidential palace.

items.title: Watch: Moment rare tornado lashes central Chinese cities
items.description: Videos shared with the BBC show debris flying through the air as the storm swept through Ezhou and Huanggang in Hubei province.

items.title: Resistance and revenge - Iran wanted to send a message with its farewell to Khamenei
items.description: Three days of public mourning in Tehran was a political spectacle Iran's leaders wanted the world to see, writes the BBC's international correspondent Lyse Doucet.

items.title: Zimbabwean football star survives gun attack in South Africa
items.description: South African police say they are investigating a case of attempted murder but that no arrests have been made so far.

items.title: India's landmark Ram temple overhauls board after alleged theft of donations
items.description: Questions have been raised over alleged theft of cash, valuable jewellery, gold and silver offered by devotees.

items.title: Erika Kirk comes face-to-face in court with husband's alleged killer
items.description: Charlie Kirk's widow was joined by the late US activist's family - all of whom attended court for the first time in the case.

items.title: Trump confirms he asked Fifa to review Balogun ban
items.description: President Donald Trump confirms he asked Fifa to review United States striker Folarin Balogun's one-match suspension at the World Cup.

items.title: Ex-Syrian intelligence chief found guilty of torture and sexual abuse by Austrian court
items.description: Two former Syrian officials went on trial in Vienna, Austria, accused of crimes against opponents of former Syrian leader Bashar al-Assad

items.title: Wildfire in southern France forces evacuation of 10,000 people
items.description: Tour de France organisers ban spectators from stage three as a wildfire hits the Pyrénées-Orientales region.
